g.text: Visible springs across the full lattice
All ten MNIST digits | Potts 1,536 | 2,970 distinct visible edges
Each heat-map pixel is one edge, located at its first endpoint; grey indicates no edge.
One linear colour scale for every map; early-time coefficients are small on this scale.

text.tspan: multiplies (−). All maps and curves use saved coefficients, not sampled trajectories.
